verdict.rationale: Token2 publishes an official open-source CLI, fido2-manage, built on libfido2 with an optional GUI. Its feature set covers passkey management, PIN and biometric management, SSH key operations, and JSON/CSV audit export, which suits scripted and agent-driven use. A PowerShell Graph API bulk-enrollment tool adds further scriptable tooling. Missing for 10: the evidence shows no command syntax or reference detail, no independent or hands-on corroboration, and no agent-oriented docs (llms.txt and markdown docs return 404).
